items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Jasper Taylor tells me about, tells me about that. We met, we met at his house

ctx.x: it's the way he does. It isn't what he does that makes me love him, it's the way he does it. Yeah. And all those kind of numbers.
Jasper Taylor, whom I saw last night... Oh, yeah. ...said to ask you about the Robichaux's,
if you played there at the Lyric Theatre. Lyric Theatre, yeah. Robichaux? Show them Robichaux? Yeah.
